claims.owner: Core/symbols.asm WRAM block (MenuScrollLevelV..SongTintContext; native cache/palette history retained)
claims.lifetime: Volatile gameplay state: menu scroll/spoof, MusicNoteValue, GoldstarOrHookshot, Kydreeok necks/offspring, FishingOrPortalRod, song tint. Last four bytes retain underlying native sheets for resource slots 0/1/2/7 across graphics loads; not persistent save data. Next 26 bytes reserve six native BG column8 reference/effective words plus state/area; no HUD, OBJ or backdrop column0 history. Finale GanondorfFight/BossReinject/FinaleBeat append at $7E1EA6-$7E1EA8 without changing native cache aliases. WallSel_Buffer $7E1EA9-$7E1EC8 (32B) is the wall-profile selector span window: written by WallSel_Common immediately before the drawer reads it through the $01:1EA9 mirror; no state carries between draws; only used when !ENABLE_WALL_PROFILE_SELECTOR == 1. SongTintContext $7E1EC9-$7E1ECA (2B) holds the $1B and area/room a song tint started in; written by SongTint_Start, read until the tint ends; only used when !ENABLE_OCARINA_SONG_TINT == 1.
claims.reset: No block-wide reset is claimed. Not in ResetTrackVars arrays since PR 211 moved this block from $7E0730 to vanilla-free $7E1E70. The last four-byte SpecialOverworldMainCache is cleared by the default-off resource callback before fresh native InitTilesets/mirror identities, then retains underlying main-sheet identities for departure restoration. Runtime qualification remains pending. Palette-hole cache reset/capture/restoration remains unbound: before any read reset state to0 and area toFF; native84-color BG refresh and Buffer/Both completion must be bound before palette activation. Main file-load entry clears the three appended Finale state bytes after native tail migration.
claims.save: Volatile WRAM; not saved.
